summary: ExlService Holdings filed an 8-K (Items 5.02, 8.01, 9.01) announcing the election of Bina Mehta as an independent director effective July 16, 2026, and a forthcoming lead director transition from Vikram Pandit to Sarah K. Williamson by end of 2026. No financial terms, premiums, or M&A activity disclosed. This is a routine board appointment and succession disclosure, not a special situation; no forced departure or event-driven change. Filing contains standard director compensation terms as per prior proxy. No action required; ordinary governance update.
